::: callout-tip
All of the zen-do commands used on this page can also be run using
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv). Why use uv? Rather than first installing zen-do
and then running a command, you can use `uvx` to install and run it in one step.
It handles correctly installing the tool in a way that your system needs. To use
`uvx` with zen-do, run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
uvx zen-do
```

To upgrade zen-do with uv, you can run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
uv tool upgrade --all
```
:::
